Grazing Strike.name: Grazing Strike
Grazing Strike.description: Strikes made with this weapon inflict half damage and inflict appropriate weapon skill effects if the strike at least matches the target's combined movement and bonus DVs.

skillStats.description: Strikes made with this weapon inflict half damage and inflict appropriate weapon skill effects if the strike at least matches the target's combined movement and bonus DVs.

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.description: The character uses their altered strike to rush 10' forward + 5' per additional rank in a straight line, making an attack roll against every target whose space they move through. They then make a single damage roll against all targets they hit, adding any applicable bonuses from Grazing Strike, Cleave Armor, Knockout, Lethal, or Concussive Strike to all successfully struck.

skillStats.description: The character uses their altered strike to rush 10' forward + 5' per additional rank in a straight line, making an attack roll against every target whose space they move through. They then make a single damage roll against all targets they hit, adding any applicable bonuses from all other sword specialization abilities to all successfully struck.

Cleave Armor.name: Cleave Armor
Cleave Armor.description: The next successful strike this turn reduces the target's armor DVs by 1 per rank until the start of the character's next turn. Cleave armor cannot reduce the target's armor DVs below 0.

Armor Reduction.name: Armor Reduction
Armor Reduction.description: Reduce the targets’ armor DVs by 1 per rank.

skillStats.description: The next successful strike this turn reduces the target's armor DVs by 1 per rank until the start of the character's next turn. Cleave armor cannot reduce the target's armor DVs below 0.

Concussive.name: Concussive
Concussive.description: The next successful strike this turn befuddles the target until the end of their next turn, HE save to negate.

Befuddled.name: Befuddled
Befuddled.description: The character loses their sense of self, spacing out occasionally. The character has a displaced roll on all PER and INT related checks as long as the condition lasts. A befuddled character cannot maintain Focus, any active focus spells are broken upon becoming befuddled.

skillStats.description: The next successful strike this turn befuddles the target until the end of their next turn, WIL save to negate.

Knockout.name: Knockout
Knockout.description: The next successful strike this turn causes the target to lose a core action until the end of their next turn, or instead be knocked unconscious if they are below half their maximum HP, their choice of a WIL or HEA save to negate either effect.

Depleted.name: Depleted
Depleted.description: the character loses their core action. or 2 action points if they are a rogue or have special action economies.

Unconcious.name: Unconcious
Unconcious.description: Unconscious targets have a number of distinctions:\nCannot perform any kind of actions and automatically fail all AGI and STR checks.

skillStats.description: The next successful strike this turn automatically grapples the target.
skillStats.condition: If  the target is  below  half  their  maximum  HP

Launch.name: Launch
Launch.description: The character executes an action, launching themselves or another target 20' per rank in any direction, AGI or STR save (target's choice) to negate. If the target is of a similar size or smaller in comparison to the character and grappled, they cannot resist the effect. This ability requires a suitable surface to push off of if used on oneself.

Lethal IV.name: Lethal IV
Lethal IV.description: Each rank purchased allows the character to add 4 damage to a single strike they make this turn.
